extraction: Team agent orchestration failure modes: (1) Handoff loss — context dropped between agents. Mitigation: unified-memory validation. (2) Role confusion — agent does another's work. Mitigation: trust boundaries. (3) Deadlock — circular wait. Mitigation: strict sequencing (Engine→Verdict→Miss). (4) Priority inversion — low-priority blocks high. Mitigation: Orchestrator preemption. Our 3-agent model addresses all four via unified-memory + trust boundaries + strict sequencing + Orchestrator control.
